subject: Evidence stitching and checkpoint plan for FedRAMP/ISO readiness
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@unitedfin.com>, John Morales <jm@auditco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence stitching and checkpoint plan for FedRAMP/ISO readiness

Hi Laura / John —

Thanks for the call earlier. As discussed, United Financial's procurement team asked for a compact set of artifacts that demonstrates both ISO 27001 alignment and our FedRAMP readiness posture so they can advance to legal and the security gate. I put together a short proposal for how we can "stitch" evidence together so auditors get a coherent narrative without excessive duplication.

High level proposal:
- Provide a single evidence index (attached: evidence_index_v1.xlsx) that maps controls to artifacts across ISO/FedRAMP/SIG.
- Deliver a SIG response draft (attached: SIG_response_draft.pdf) covering the customer-specific questions, with references to the index.
- Offer a 60-minute walkthrough with John (audit lead) and their security team the week of Feb 22 to explain where each artifact lives and who owns it.

Requests from United Financial that we should confirm today:
1) Exact retention samples they want (specific logs/time windows).
2) Any additional evidence for KMS/HSM usage and key rotation schedules.
3) Whether they require auditor access to our staging environment for a short observation window.

Can you confirm availability for the walkthrough? Also looping in Marissa and Karthik to assign evidence owners for the items in the index. I'll update the spreadsheet with owners once we agree.

Thanks —
David Kim
Senior Security PM | Redwood Inference
David.Kim@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: evidence_index_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SIG_response_draft.pdf (PDF)
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@unitedfin.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: audit@clarity-audit.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence stitching and checkpoint plan for FedRAMP/ISO readiness

David —

Appreciate the concise plan and the attachments. A few quick clarifications from our security intake:
- Retention samples: we want a 30-day window for auth logs, plus a 90-day window for admin activity logs. If we could point to a daily snapshot or sample reports, that would be ideal.
- KMS: we need key rotation policy plus a sample KMS audit entry showing a key rotation event.
- Staging access: possibly — legal will decide, but security would like a short remote session where John can validate controls and ask follow-ups; not full credentials.

We're available for a walkthrough on Tue Feb 23 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed Feb 24 14:00–15:00 PT. Which works for your team and for John?

Laura Chen
Director, Vendor Risk Management
United Financial
laura.chen@unitedfin.com
From: John Morales <jm@auditco.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@unitedfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 13:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence stitching and checkpoint plan for FedRAMP/ISO readiness

David / Laura —

Thanks for the index. A couple of quick audit asks before the walkthrough so I can prep:
- Can you flag any mutable artifacts (logs, ephemeral infra screenshots) vs. static artifacts (policies, diagrams) in the index? We prefer a clear column for artifact type and sample instructions.
- For KV cache / inference runtime evidence, indicate sequence length and token retention posture — auditors have asked about caching and how it affects data residency.
- If you can attach one KMS rotation event (redact key material) and a sample log export in CSV format, that will speed our review.

I can do Tue Feb 23 at 10:00 PT. Tentatively confirmed on my calendar.

John Morales
Lead Auditor | AuditCo
jm@auditco.com
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: John Morales <jm@auditco.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@unitedfin.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 16:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence stitching and checkpoint plan for FedRAMP/ISO readiness

Team —

Thanks — John confirmed Tue 2/23 at 10:00 PT. Action items (assign below so I can update the index and send the walkthrough invite):

- Marissa: please add an "artifact_type" column to the evidence index and mark the items that are mutable vs static. Also include a one-line sample instruction for each mutable item (e.g., "export auth logs 2027-01-15 to 2027-02-14, redacted IPs").
- Karthik: can you pull a KMS rotation event log and redact secrets? If we can provide a single event CSV and note the rotation policy doc link, that should satisfy the ask.
- Priya: please draft a short paragraph (2–3 bullets) on our inference KV caching behavior and data residency controls — auditors want to understand whether cached tokens persist and where.

I'll update evidence_index_v1.xlsx with these owners and attach at least one sample log before Tue morning. Also prepping the SIG_response_draft.pdf with cross-refs to the index.

Marissa / Karthik / Priya — if you hit any blockers or need more context from John or Laura before Tuesday, reply-all and I'll escalate.

Best,
David
